source.rationale: New change-type category: the function's RETURN type changes (plain dict -> a custom Result object), not any parameter. Entry 20's change_type classification is built around the argument list specifically ('signature-vs-body-only change classification... comparing just the function's argument-list AST') -- a return-type-only change may not be captured by that classifier at all, since the argument list itself is unchanged. This case exists to check whether return-type staleness is detected upstream at all, independent of what the Verifier/Corrector then do with it.

labels.notes_for_labeler: CONFIRMED (real run). Resolves the open detection question: a return-type-only change (dict -> custom object, argument list unchanged) DOES reach the Verifier and get correctly diagnosed and fixed ('result["value"]' -> 'result.value'). Clean proposed/approved, exactly matching human_fixed_doc_section. No completeness gap here since only one usage site existed in the example.
